name: Foveated Volume Extraction in Wavelet Domain
definition: A method to extract a subset of wavelet coefficients ($W_f$) required to reconstruct a Region of Interest (ROI) at various resolution layers, reducing data size for transmission.
summary: Foveated Volume Extraction in Wavelet Domain selectively extracts wavelet coefficients to reconstruct a specific region of interest across all resolution layers, enabling efficient high-resolution 3D volume rendering with significant data compression.
